inciting: A signal appears on a dead frequency.
The prototype activates without a power source.
rising: The readings begin changing faster than anyone can explain.
A hidden message reveals that someone expected them to arrive.
climax: The team finally reaches the source of the signal.
The machine opens a portal that cannot remain stable for long.
ending: The signal stops, but one last light remains on the console.
They leave with more questions than answers, carrying a new map.

inciting: A locked door opens by itself.
A voice answers from an empty room.
rising: The lights fail one by one while footsteps circle the group.
An old recording reveals what happened to the previous occupants.
climax: The group confronts whatever has been following them.
The final room contains evidence that the nightmare is not over.
ending: At sunrise, everything looks normal except for one open door.
Silence returns, but a new voice can be heard on the recording.

inciting: The plan fails before it even begins.
Someone accidentally sends the secret message to the wrong person.
rising: Every attempted solution somehow creates a bigger problem.
The team discovers that their biggest enemy is their own misunderstanding.
climax: The final plan is improvised in under thirty seconds.
Everyone commits to the worst idea they have heard all day.
ending: The problem is solved mostly by accident.
They walk away arguing about who gets credit for the disaster.

inciting: An anonymous file arrives with a deadline attached.
A witness disappears before giving the final piece of evidence.
rising: The clues point toward someone inside the team.
A second message proves the enemy knows their every move.
climax: The final confrontation begins before anyone is ready.
The team must choose between the evidence and saving a life.
ending: The case appears closed, but one unanswered clue remains.
The truth reaches the public, while the real architect disappears.
